Chemical Composition Test Report 31 checkpoints across 5 sections.Chemical analysis required for every heat / lot of steel received. Minimum frequency: 1 test per 40 MT (for TMT bars) or per heat number, whichever is greater. Also performed when MTC is unavailable or discrepancies noted.
